group_assessment.weighting: A paediatric hospital neuro-metabolic group with an electrophysiology collaborator, studying ferroptosis markers in epilepsy; WWOX is not named. Wet-lab halves: blots and enzymatic assays on acute slices from wild-type mice; clinical half: four children against five controls. Observation (band densitometry, one example trace, a four-versus-five mRNA comparison) is weighted well above interpretation (ferroptosis as crucial contributor, xCT as a therapeutic target and peripheral biomarker).

entries.proposition: System: acute coronal cortical slices from wild-type C57BL/6J mice aged P30 to P40, male and female.
entries.snippet: Cortical slices were obtained from postnatal (P) day P30–P40 old animals (male and female)

entries.proposition: Sample size: 3 to 10 slices from at least 3 mice per approach; blots are three independent experiments.
entries.snippet: data were collected from several slices (3–10) obtained at least from 3 different mice

entries.proposition: Statistics: Student's t-test between two groups, with comparisons to untreated samples at two time points.
entries.snippet: Statistically significant differences between two groups were analyzed using Student

entries.proposition: RSL-3 at 5 uM lowered GPX4 by 36 and 47 percent at 15 min and 1 h and raised 15-LOX 4.5- and 5.3-fold; ferroptosis itself (cell death, lipid ROS) is not measured in the slices.
entries.snippet: A 36 and 47% reduction was found, respectively, after 15 min and 1 h exposure to RSL-3 (5 μM)

entries.proposition: Cysteine fell by 41 and 32 percent but the difference is declared not significant, under a heading that says RSL-3 decreases cysteine.
entries.snippet: Although these values were not significantly different, the reduced expression of cysteine may contribute to slow down GSH synthesis

entries.proposition: The cystine/glutamate antiporter protein rose 2.4- and 3.4-fold, the opposite of a deficiency, read as compensation.
entries.snippet: Surprisingly, we found a significant 2.4- and 3.4-fold increase of the protein amount after 15 min and 1 h treatment

entries.proposition: 4-HNE at 10 uM is reported to induce interictal bursts within 15 min, persisting after washout.
entries.snippet: the application of 4-HNE in the bath induced, within 15 min, an enhancement of spontaneous synaptic activity in cortical slices and the appearance of epileptogenic interictal bursts

entries.proposition: Figure 5 legend states the recording is whole-cell current clamp at -70 mV from one layer 2/3 pyramidal neuron.
entries.snippet: Whole cell patch clamp recordings (-70mV) in current clamp configuration from a layer 2/3 pyramidal neuron

entries.proposition: Figure 5 shows one control and one 4-HNE trace from one cell with a current calibration (20 pA) although the legend says current clamp; no vehicle trace, no cell count and no burst quantification are given.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5: upper trace Control with isolated spikes and a small asterisk, lower trace 4 HNE (10 uM) with dense repetitive spike bursts and an asterisk; calibration bars 5 s and 20 pA and an expanded 0.5 s segment at right; no vehicle trace, no n, no summary plot.

experimental_context.system: acute mouse cortical slice, layer 2/3 pyramidal neuron

entries.qualifies_needle: Whole cell patch clamp recordings (-70mV) in current clamp configuration

entries.proposition: Figure 6 shows 15-LOX and SLC7A11 bands under 4-HNE that are faint in the cropped blots, quantified as 1.5- to 2.2-fold.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 6A-B: bar charts of 15-LOX and SLC7A11 densitometry (percent of control, three points per bar, asterisks) beside cropped blots whose 15-LOX and SLC7A11 bands are faint and close in intensity across control, 15 min and 1 h lanes, with strong beta-actin bands below.

entries.proposition: Patients: four children with epilepsy against five healthy children, leukocyte SLC7A11 mRNA only; no diagnosis, medication or seizure data are given in the Methods.
entries.snippet: Blood samples from four children with epilepsy were collected into EDTA Vacutainer Tubes

entries.proposition: The four-versus-five comparison is presented as evidence for a peripheral biomarker mirroring brain changes.
entries.snippet: thus providing evidence for this protein as a potential peripheral biomarker in epilepsy, able to mirror pathological changes occurring in the brain

entries.proposition: Figure 7 plots four patient points (about 1.9 to 3.4) against five control points (about 0.7 to 1.35).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 7: bar chart of mRNA SCL7A11 fold change, Controls five round points around 1.0 (about 0.7 to 1.35), Patients four square points about 1.9, 2.2, 2.7 and 3.4 with ** above the patient bar.

entries.proposition: The conclusion asserts a role of ferroptosis in epilepsy development and proposes combination therapy, while conceding the coordination of processes is not understood.
entries.snippet: Ferroptosis plays a role in the development of epilepsy.

entries.proposition: Supplementary Data Sheet 1 full blots: each full blot carries four lanes although the figures show three conditions (control, 15 min, 1 h); the lane order is not labelled; and the beta-actin images given for Figure 1A, Figure 2B and Figure 4 show the same band pattern, which is expected if one membrane was reprobed but is not stated on the sheet.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Data Sheet 1, page 1: Figure 1A GPX4 full blot with four lanes (first lane dark, three lighter) beside Figure 1A b-Actin with a red marker dot at left and an arrowed band; lower on the page the Figure 2B b-Actin full blot has the same lane layout, red dot and band pattern; Figure 1B 15-Lox full blot four lanes with a molecular weight marker; page 2: Figure 6A and 6B 15-LOX and SLC7A11 full blots are dark smeared strips with several bands and an arrow.

entries.proposition: Text on GSH: levels are said to be decreased 'to 64 and 52 percent' at 15 min and 1 h of RSL-3.
entries.snippet: the GSH concentration was consistently decreased to 64 and 52% at 15 min and 1 h after RSL-3-treatment

entries.proposition: Figure 2A: GSH is about 175 (control), 65 (15 min) and 85 (1 h) nmol/mg protein, i.e. about 37 and 49 percent of control remaining, a fall of about 63 and 51 percent; the text 'decreased to 64 and 52 percent' reads as the size of the fall, not the remaining level.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2A: bar chart GSH nmol/mg prot 0 to 200, Ctrls about 175, RSL-3 15 min about 65, RSL-3 1 h about 85, three points per bar, three asterisks on each RSL-3 bar; Figure 2B Gcl densitometry (percent A.U.) about 100, 46 and 54 with a Gcl over b-Actin blot.
entries.qualifies_needle: the GSH concentration was consistently decreased to 64 and 52%
